idea-plugin.name: Manage Keymap Conflicts
idea-plugin.description:
Adds the MacBook Pro DE keymap: a macOS keymap for MacBook Pro keyboards with German (T1) layout, avoiding shortcuts that are physically unpressable there (keys like / = ; ' ` [ ] exist only as Shift/Option chords on the German layout, and there is no numpad or Insert key). After installing, select MacBook Pro DE under Settings → Keymap.

Includes a live conflict report (macOS system shortcuts and in-keymap overlaps, with advice per conflict), reachable any time from Tools → Review Keymap Conflicts or Find Action.

action.description: Manage a keymap's shortcut conflicts with macOS and within the keymap
